name: Shaft tombs
summary: Twelve narrow burial shafts, 8 to 30 m deep, each ending in a small chamber, in fractured limestone over sound bedrock. The scale of Giza's cemeteries: the positive control any claim must pass.

frame.axes: x east, y north, z up; metres

features.name: Shaft 1 (16 m)
features.source: Representative: dimensions after Idu (G 7102 C) and Hetepheres I (G 7000 X) in sim/legacy/catalog/giza/surveys.json; positions and depths chosen to span the 5-30 m band.
